title: Annual Gala Dinner & Awards 2025
content:
Join Us for an Evening of Celebration and Recognition

The African Christian Business Fellowship (ACBF) Republic of South Africa is thrilled to invite you to our Annual Gala Dinner & Awards event. This prestigious evening promises to be a memorable celebration of excellence, fellowship, and the building of lasting legacies in the Christian business community.

Event Details

  • Date: Friday, 28 November 2025
  • Time: 18:00 to 22:00
  • Venue: Emperors Palace, Kempton Park

Ticket Information

  • Standard Tickets: R1,000 per person
  • VIP Tickets: R3,000 per person

Theme: Building a Legacy that Lasts. Fruit that Remains

This year's theme is inspired by the biblical principles of building lasting legacies and producing fruit that remains. We will explore how Christian business leaders can create meaningful impact that extends beyond their immediate success.

"You did not choose me, but I chose you and appointed you so that you might go and bear fruit—fruit that will last—and so that whatever you ask in my name the Father will give you." - John 15:16

"Praise the Lord. Blessed are those who fear the Lord, who find great delight in his commands. Their children will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed. Wealth and riches are in their houses, and their righteousness endures forever." - Psalm 112:1-3

What to Expect

  • Elegant dinner and networking opportunities
  • Recognition of outstanding achievements in Christian business
  • Inspiring keynote addresses
  • Awards ceremony honoring excellence in various categories
  • Fellowship with like-minded Christian business leaders
  • Entertainment and celebration

RSVP Information

RSVP Deadline: 15 November 2025

To secure your place at this prestigious event, please RSVP by the deadline. Spaces are limited, and early booking is recommended.

Contact Information

  • ACBF RSA: +27 76 775 0044
  • G Chinomona: +27 73 416 3323
  • Email: Info@acbf.org.za
  • Website: www.acbf.org.za

Dress Code

Formal/Black Tie attire is requested for this elegant evening.

We look forward to celebrating with you and building lasting legacies together in the Christian business community.
excerpt: Join us for the Annual Gala Dinner & Awards on 28 November 2025 at Emperors Palace, Kempton Park. An evening of celebration, recognition, and fellowship. Theme: Building a Legacy that Lasts. Fruit that Remains.
author: ACBF RSA

title: Sandton summit targets investment and global partnerships for African businesses
content:
JOHANNESBURG — Access to investment and opportunities for cross-border business partnerships will be central to the ACBF International Investment Summit, scheduled for 26–28 November 2026 at The Maslow Hotel in Sandton.

Convened by the Africa Christian Business Fellowship (ACBF), the three-day event is being organised to connect entrepreneurs with investors and business leaders. The planned programme includes investment presentations, investor matching and closed-door investment meetings, alongside an Awards Night recognising business achievement.

The organisers aim to help entrepreneurs present business opportunities to potential funders and commercial partners. The summit’s focus on African enterprise and diaspora connections places market access and business relationships alongside the search for capital.

The international reach is reflected in the current awards nomination list, which contains 139 entries across 31 categories. Nominees are listed in nine countries: South Africa, Zimbabwe, Namibia, Botswana, Lesotho, Zambia, Australia, the United Kingdom and the United States.

Award categories cover manufacturing and industrial development, financial services, healthcare, construction, agriculture, and transport and logistics. Separate categories recognise business leadership, women in business, youth entrepreneurship, job creation and skills development, community impact, and lifetime achievement.

Among the businesses listed are Namibia’s Integris Financial Services, nominated for Financial Services Excellence; Afri Expo Textiles in Lesotho, nominated for Job Creation and Skills Development; and Australia’s PNM Designs, nominated for Built Environment Excellence. South Africa’s Megashift Logistics is among the nominees for Transport & Logistics Excellence.

ACBF’s regional activity earlier this year included the launch of its Zambia chapter in Lusaka. Forward In Faith Ministries International reported that the launch took place alongside investment engagements from 1–4 July 2026, involving discussions with government officials and other stakeholders.

Alongside its commercial focus, ACBF’s summit communications highlight the fellowship’s Christian identity and the place of ethical leadership and community responsibility in business.

The event’s advertised registration fees are US$300 for Standard, US$500 for VIP and US$1,000 for VVIP, or the equivalent in local currency.

Event and media enquiries can be directed to info@acbf.org.za or +27 76 775 0044.
excerpt: The ACBF International Investment Summit, 26–28 November 2026 at The Maslow Hotel in Sandton, will pair an investment programme with awards across 31 categories.
author: ACBF RSA
